acceptance_criteria: Self-contained written derivation of conservative ddt + rho_cont + psi=drho/dp|_h, ready for the paper methods section.
description: By-hand analytical derivation of the conservative energy discretisation that fixed the Edwards blowdown plateau collapse (op-21g.14). Author's own derivation for the paper methods (Phase II row A of the Edwards debug timeline table, outram_park_th_paper/src/index.tex). Derive: (1) from the integral energy conservation law, the discrete conservative ddt (rho*h - rho_old*h_old)/dt, and show the h*div(rho u) term cancels against discrete continuity (the cancellation the non-conservative rho*dh/dt form breaks, dropping a term ~ h*(rho-rho_old)/dt that over-drains enthalpy during flashing); (2) why the storage density must be continuity-consistent rho_cont = rho_old - dt*div(phi), not the EOS density; (3) the effective compressibility psi = drho/dp|_h and why frozen isothermal kappa_T is ~100x too small in the two-phase dome (omits flashing term) -- this psi produces the flashing plateau.
title: Derive by hand: TampinesSteamArray discrete energy-conservation formulation (for paper methods)
